title: With `invoke_without_command` set, commands are not marked as optional
body:
Having

```python
@click.group(invoke_without_command=True)
def main():
    if ctx.invoked_subcommand is not None:
        return
    # do something by default
```

I expect `--help` to output:

```text
Usage: app.py [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

But it outputs:

```text
Usage: app.py [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Environment: Python 3.11.8, Click 8.2.0.
